name: compact-lens
description: See what a compaction takes away and what it leaves, pin facts that must survive it, and edit the summary afterwards.

warnAtPercent.title: Warn at
warnAtPercent.description: Context fill, as a percent of the window, at which the model gets one note ahead of the compaction. 0 turns the note off.

dir.title: Snapshot folder
dir.description: Where the snapshots go. Empty means ~/.claude/compact-lens.

openPane.title: Open the pane at start
openPane.description: Open the Compact Lens pane when a session starts. A wide terminal seats it; a narrow one keeps it waiting.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Keep a line under the prompt with the context fill, the compactions so far and the pinned notes.
